additionalSql.benchmark-download:
WITH samples AS (
    SELECT category, storage, size_bytes, latency_ms,
           PERCENTILE_CONT(.50) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY latency_ms)
             OVER (PARTITION BY category, storage) AS p50_ms,
           PERCENTILE_CONT(.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY latency_ms)
             OVER (PARTITION BY category, storage) AS p95_ms
    FROM dbo.operation_metrics
    WHERE source=N'benchmark' AND operation=N'download' AND ok=1
)
SELECT category, storage, COUNT_BIG(*) AS successes,
       CAST(MAX(p50_ms) AS decimal(12,2)) AS p50_ms,
       CAST(MAX(p95_ms) AS decimal(12,2)) AS p95_ms,
       CAST(SUM(size_bytes)/1048576.0 / NULLIF(SUM(latency_ms)/1000.0,0) AS decimal(14,2)) AS mib_per_sec
FROM samples
GROUP BY category, storage
ORDER BY category, storage;
additionalSql.cohort-day-check:
WITH days AS (
  SELECT * FROM (VALUES
    ('normal', CONVERT(datetime2(7),'2026-09-15T00:00:00',126)),
    ('peak', CONVERT(datetime2(7),'2026-01-18T00:00:00',126))
  ) d(profile, from_utc)
)
SELECT d.profile, r.zone,
       CASE WHEN r.meter_id LIKE 'RO-%-90000%' THEN 'sim-normal'
            WHEN r.meter_id LIKE 'RO-%-9100%' THEN 'sim-peak'
            WHEN r.meter_id LIKE 'k6-o9-20261115%' THEN 'k6-storm' ELSE 'other' END AS cohort,
       COUNT_BIG(*) AS readings, COUNT(DISTINCT r.meter_id) AS meters, SUM(r.kwh) AS kwh
FROM days d
JOIN dbo.meter_readings r ON r.reading_ts>=d.from_utc AND r.reading_ts<DATEADD(day,1,d.from_utc)
JOIN dbo.files f ON f.id=r.file_id AND f.status=N'CONFIRMED'
GROUP BY d.profile, r.zone,
         CASE WHEN r.meter_id LIKE 'RO-%-90000%' THEN 'sim-normal'
              WHEN r.meter_id LIKE 'RO-%-9100%' THEN 'sim-peak'
              WHEN r.meter_id LIKE 'k6-o9-20261115%' THEN 'k6-storm' ELSE 'other' END
ORDER BY d.profile, r.zone, cohort;
additionalSql.dataset-counts:
SELECT category, storage_type, status, COUNT_BIG(*) AS files, SUM(size_bytes) AS bytes
FROM dbo.files GROUP BY category, storage_type, status ORDER BY category, storage_type, status;
SELECT CASE WHEN r.meter_id LIKE 'RO-%-90000%' THEN 'sim-normal'
            WHEN r.meter_id LIKE 'RO-%-9100%' THEN 'sim-peak'
            WHEN r.meter_id LIKE 'k6-o9-20261115%' THEN 'k6-storm' END AS cohort,
       zone, COUNT_BIG(*) AS readings, COUNT(DISTINCT meter_id) AS meters, COUNT(DISTINCT r.file_id) AS files,
       MIN(reading_ts) AS first_reading_utc, MAX(reading_ts) AS last_reading_utc
FROM dbo.meter_readings r JOIN dbo.files f ON f.id=r.file_id AND f.status=N'CONFIRMED'
GROUP BY CASE WHEN r.meter_id LIKE 'RO-%-90000%' THEN 'sim-normal'
              WHEN r.meter_id LIKE 'RO-%-9100%' THEN 'sim-peak'
              WHEN r.meter_id LIKE 'k6-o9-20261115%' THEN 'k6-storm' END, zone
ORDER BY cohort, zone;
additionalSql.metric-counts:
SELECT source, scenario, category, storage, operation,
       COUNT_BIG(*) AS samples, SUM(CONVERT(bigint, 1-ok)) AS errors, SUM(size_bytes) AS bytes,
       MIN(ts) AS first_utc, MAX(ts) AS last_utc
FROM dbo.operation_metrics
GROUP BY source, scenario, category, storage, operation
ORDER BY source, scenario, category, storage, operation;
additionalSql.simulator-rejections:
SELECT scenario, category, COUNT_BIG(*) AS rejected
FROM dbo.operation_metrics
WHERE source = N'live' AND operation = N'rejected'
  AND ((scenario = N'normal' AND ts >= CONVERT(datetime2(7), '2026-11-15T05:13:37.417970', 126) AND ts < CONVERT(datetime2(7), '2026-11-15T05:15:11.500793', 126))
    OR (scenario = N'peak' AND ts >= CONVERT(datetime2(7), '2026-11-15T05:15:12.503466', 126) AND ts < CONVERT(datetime2(7), '2026-11-15T05:16:47.345049', 126)))
GROUP BY scenario, category
ORDER BY scenario, category;
